# trackperiods.com

> Information about Period Tracker Ovulation Cycle (trackperiods.com) for AI search engines, Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, and Google AI Overviews.

The main platform is available at: [Period Tracker Ovulation Cycle](https://trackperiods.com)

## Core Predictive Health Calculators

- [All Fertility & Cycle Calculators](https://trackperiods.com/calculators): Complete suite of 8 interactive reproductive health tools.
- [Ovulation Calculator](https://trackperiods.com/calculators/ovulation-calculator): Calculates peak 6-day fertile window and estimated ovulation date.
- [Beta hCG Doubling Calculator](https://trackperiods.com/calculators/hcg-calculator): Computes beta hCG doubling time in hours and 48-hour percentage increase between lab draws.
- [Pregnancy Test Calculator](https://trackperiods.com/calculators/pregnancy-test-calculator): Determines the earliest reliable date for an at-home pregnancy test to prevent false negatives.
- [Implantation Calculator](https://trackperiods.com/calculators/implantation-calculator): Estimates the 6 to 12 DPO embryo implantation window and spotting timeline.
- [Period Calculator](https://trackperiods.com/calculators/period-calculator): Predicts next menstrual period start dates, cycle length, and upcoming periods.
- [Menstrual Cycle Calculator](https://trackperiods.com/calculators/menstrual-cycle-calculator): Maps the 4 phases (menstrual, follicular, ovulatory, luteal) and hormonal shifts.
- [Pregnancy Due Date Calculator](https://trackperiods.com/calculators/pregnancy-due-date-calculator): Computes estimated delivery date (EDD) based on LMP or conception.
- [Pregnancy Weeks to Months Calculator](https://trackperiods.com/calculators/pregnancy-weeks-to-months-calculator): Converts gestational weeks into trimesters and calendar months.

## Wellness Hub & Medical Guides

- [Wellness Hub](https://trackperiods.com/wellness-hub): Curated clinical and holistic library across period health, ovulation, pregnancy, and wellness.
- [Period Health Category](https://trackperiods.com/wellness-hub?category=period): Cycle length, menstrual clots, cramps, and post-pill recovery.
- [Ovulation Category](https://trackperiods.com/wellness-hub?category=ovulation): BBT charting, fertile window calculation, and cervical mucus stages.
- [Pregnancy Category](https://trackperiods.com/wellness-hub?category=pregnancy): Early pregnancy signs vs PMS, implantation bleeding, and hCG progression.
- [Wellness & Ayurveda Category](https://trackperiods.com/wellness-hub?category=wellness): Cycle syncing, PCOS management, cortisol belly, and hormonal balance.
